# Interface: MultigridOptions

Optional pressure-cycle tuning. Normally the internal defaults are sufficient.

## Properties

<a id="bottomiterations"></a>

### bottomIterations?

```ts
optional bottomIterations?: number;
```

Smoothing at the actual bottom of the usable hierarchy. Defaults to 12.

***

### postSmoothing?

```ts
optional postSmoothing?: number;
```

### preSmoothing?

```ts
optional preSmoothing?: number;
```
